card.name: Words just before North American place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of', 'new' or an opening bracket right before a place or species name, often in texts about the Americas, Canada or the New World.

modes.label: Before 'Americas' or border
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' leading into a hemisphere or border phrase.
modes.example: Efforts towards a hemisphere-wide Free Trade Area of<< the>> Americas fell apart in November 20

modes.label: 'New' before a place name
modes.description: 'New' leading into Zealand, World or Polymer Series.
modes.example: Black against gold:<< New>> Zealand-Australia sporting rivalry in the modern

modes.label: Bracket after a place or species
modes.description: An opening bracket after a city or species name, before a code or Latin name.

card.writes: It suppresses Canada and America words, so it steers the next word away from those names.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a place name, especially in Americas and Canada-related text.
